sources: UET ECAT — About ECAT (ecat.uet.edu.pk), checked 9 Nov 2026

head: Item
ECAT 2026
rows: None (it was −1 per wrong answer in 2025)
Computer-based test (CBT), one question per screen
Not allowed; rough paper is provided

blocks.text: With no negative marking, never leave a question blank. Guess if you must.
Every paper has 10 English questions and 30 questions in each of three subjects. Your combination must match your intermediate subjects.
This app covers the Pre-Engineering combination.

UET says the test covers the entire Intermediate (FSc), A-Level or DAE syllabus and publishes no shortened chapter list. Questions ask you to solve problems with intermediate-level concepts, not just recall.
English is reading comprehension: short passages followed by questions.

items: Two ECAT attempts per Fall intake, usually in March and June.
A score counts only for that year's Fall admissions.
There is no re-checking of results.

blocks.text: There is no ECAT pass mark, but the aggregate must be at least 50 %. In Fall 2026 the first merit lists at UET Lahore closed at roughly 82 to 88 % aggregate for open merit.
In 2026 the average Pre-Engineering score was about 203/400 in the first attempt and 238/400 in the second. Every mark matters.
